subject: Labor: health and safety
bill.title: Labor: health and safety; occupational health standards related to exposure to work in hot environments; require director to promulgate. Amends 1974 PA 154 (MCL 408.1001 - 408.1094) by adding sec. 14s.

posted_text:
🦺 MI HB 6442 — Michigan Could Require Employers to Protect Workers From Extreme Heat

Bill would force companies to create plans to prevent heat injuries, including temperature monitoring, regular water breaks, and employee training.

Employers would also be required to track and report any illnesses or deaths related to heat exposure.

The director could set specific temperature thresholds for these requirements, and the law would prevent employers from retaliating against workers who report heat hazards.

If the federal government creates its own heat safety standards, Michigan’s rules would step back to allow for coordination.

Nov. 5, 2026: Bill electronically reproduced 10/28/2026.
